gloss: sea mail; surface mail; ship transport

definitions.gloss: sea mail; surface mail; shipping by sea
definitions.explanation: Mail, packages, or cargo sent by ship rather than by air. Slower but cheaper than airmail, commonly used for heavy or bulky items.

examples.japanese: {船便|ふなびん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: It's cheaper to send by sea mail.

examples.japanese: {船便|ふなびん}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧２⟦{ヶ月|かげつ}→ヶ月：00956_kagetsu⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: By sea mail, it takes two months to arrive.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{船便|ふなびん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}り→送る：00742_okuru⟧、⟦{身|み}の{回|まわ}り→身の回り：07854_minomawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{航空便|こうくうびん}→航空便：24353_koukuubin⟧にした。
examples.english: I sent the moving boxes by sea and only shipped personal essentials by air.

notes:
Composed of {船|ふな} (ship, combining form) + ⟦{便|びん}→便：28160_bin⟧ (mail, service). Note that ⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧ changes to {船|ふな} in compounds. This is a practical word for anyone living abroad or sending international packages.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {船便|ふなびん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to send by sea mail
- {船便|ふなびん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧: to arrive by sea mail
- {船便|ふなびん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: sea mail rates

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{航空便|こうくうびん}→航空便：24353_koukuubin⟧: airmail — faster but more expensive
- SAL{便|びん}: economy airmail — intermediate speed and cost
- ⟦{小包|こづつみ}→小包：02764_kozutsumi⟧: parcel, package — refers to the item, not the shipping method
